description: ucla_plha: A Probabilistic Liquefaction Hazard Assessment Python Package is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "software", published or maintained by Meera Kota, University of California Los Angeles (ucla.edu). The uclaplha Python package performs probabilistic liquefaction hazard analysis (PLHA) to quantify the annual rate of liquefaction in California. The code integrates probabilistic seismic hazard analysis (PSHA) using the Uniform California Earthquake Rupture Forecast, Version 3 (UCERF3, Field et al. 2017) source model and ground motion models from the NGAWest2 project (Bozorgnia et al. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "software" project. Its DOI is 10.17603/ds2-x569-qv57. Keywords: Liquefaction,  Hazard Analysis . Published 2025-10-30. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 3-Clause BSD License. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
